verdict.rationale: Wave's public pages document no CLI, headless mode, or CI-oriented automation surface; the pack itself notes they show no API, MCP, CLI, or webhook surface. A probe confirms only that a GraphQL endpoint answers one unauthenticated introspection query, with no documentation of authentication, mutations, or automation use. A bare endpoint is at most a developer building block, not a documented headless/CI capability. The in-app automations (recurring invoices, reminders, bank import) are adjacent features, not headless operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
